summary: AvosLocker was a RaaS that appeared in mid-2021 and hit US critical infrastructure. Its leak site went offline in July 2023 and no activity has been seen since May 2023. Affiliates got in through exploited internet-facing apps such as Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus and Atlassian Confluence, and through abused remote-administration tools. They then used a heavy legitimate toolkit (AnyDesk, Splashtop, Atera, Tactical RMM, PDQ Deploy, Chisel/Ligolo, Cobalt Strike, Sliver, Mimikatz, LaZagne, Rclone, FileZilla). Distinctive moves were rebooting into Safe Mode with AnyDesk set to start there, killing AV through Avast's anti-rootkit driver (aswArPot.sys), Nmap-based Log4Shell scanning, and a Linux variant that kills ESXi VMs before encrypting them.
uniqueTraits: Configures AnyDesk to run in Safe Mode (with networking), reboots into Safe Mode and launches the ransomware there
BYOVD: Avast anti-rootkit driver aswArPot.sys driven by a PowerShell script to kill security processes
Scans for Log4Shell across endpoints with an Nmap NSE script
Custom NetMonitor.exe masquerading as a network tool, acting as a reverse proxy over 443
Linux/ESXi variant that enumerates and force-kills running VMs before encryption

chain.procedure: Exploits Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus (suspected CVE-2021-40539) and Atlassian Confluence servers to gain an initial foothold.
chain.noAtomicReason: No local atomic exploits ManageEngine or Confluence. Validate with web-app process-ancestry analytics (java/tomcat spawning cmd/powershell) and the follow-on web-shell step.

chain.procedure: Deploys custom web shells to keep network access.

atomics.note: Writes a web shell into a web-server directory.

chain.procedure: Abuses legitimate RMM and remote-access tools as access vectors and for persistence: Splashtop Streamer, Tactical RMM, AnyDesk, Atera Agent, PuTTY.

atomics.note: Runs Splashtop Streamer.

atomics.testName: AnyDesk Files Detected Test on Windows
atomics.note: Runs AnyDesk.

chain.procedure: Runs custom PowerShell and .bat scripts for execution, lateral movement and turning off antivirus.

atomics.note: Runs a PowerShell command.
Creates and runs a batch script.

chain.procedure: Runs Nmap with an NSE script to scan endpoints for Log4Shell, and uses an RDP scanner.

atomics.note: An Nmap port scan from Windows, the same tool used for the Log4Shell NSE sweep.

atomics.testName: Remote Desktop Services Discovery via PowerShell
atomics.note: Discovers Remote Desktop Services, like the RDP scanner.

chain.procedure: Runs Nltest through scripts to enumerate domain controllers and trusts.

atomics.note: Discovers domain controllers with nltest.

atomics.testName: Windows - Discover domain trusts with nltest
atomics.note: Discovers domain trusts with nltest.

chain.procedure: A PowerShell script uses Avast's legitimate anti-rootkit driver aswArPot.sys (BYOVD) to terminate a list of security processes.

atomics.testName: Kill antimalware protected processes using Backstab
atomics.note: Kills protected security processes through a signed kernel driver (Backstab), the same BYOVD process-kill pattern.

atomics.testName: Scattered Spider BYOVD (CVE-2015-2291 for Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver)
atomics.note: Loads a known-vulnerable signed driver as a kernel service.
Runs Mimikatz against LSASS.

chain.procedure: Runs LaZagne to recover stored browser and application passwords.

atomics.note: Recovers browser credentials with LaZagne.
Loots local credentials with LaZagne through WinPwn.

chain.procedure: Tunnels C2 with Ligolo and Chisel, alongside Cobalt Strike and Sliver.

atomics.note: Opens a reverse tunnel with ngrok, a tunneling tool in the same class as Chisel and Ligolo.

atomics.testName: Cobalt Strike post-exploitation pipe (4.2 and later)
atomics.note: Creates Cobalt Strike post-exploitation named pipes.

chain.techniqueName: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Resource Name or Location
chain.procedure: Runs NetMonitor.exe, a custom tool that poses as a legitimate network-monitoring process, pings every five minutes and acts as a reverse proxy over port 443.

atomics.testName: Masquerade as a built-in system executable
atomics.note: Runs a binary masquerading as a legitimate system executable.

chain.procedure: Moves laterally and pushes payloads with PsExec, Impacket and PDQ Deploy mass deployment.

atomics.testName: Use PsExec to execute a command on a remote host
atomics.note: Runs a remote command with PsExec.
Deploys a payload with PDQ Deploy.
Impacket wmiexec remote execution.

chain.techniqueName: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility
chain.procedure: Compresses collected data with 7-Zip before exfiltration.

atomics.testName: Compress Data and lock with password for Exfiltration with 7zip
atomics.note: Builds a password-protected 7-Zip archive.

chain.procedure: Exfiltrates data with FileZilla (FTP) and Rclone for data-leak extortion.

atomics.testName: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol - FTP - Rclone
atomics.note: Exfiltrates over FTP with Rclone.

atomics.testName: Exfiltrate data with rclone to cloud Storage - Mega (Windows)
atomics.note: Rclone exfiltration to cloud storage.

chain.procedure: Sets AnyDesk to run in Safe Mode, tries to disable security components that also run there, reboots into Safe Mode and launches the ransomware.

atomics.testName: Windows Add Registry Value to Load Service in Safe Mode with Network
atomics.note: Registers a service under SafeBoot\Network so it loads in Safe Mode with networking, which is how AnyDesk stays reachable.
Sets safeboot with bcdedit.

chain.procedure: The Linux/ESXi variant checks for ESXi/VMFS, lists running VMs and force-kills them before encrypting the VM files.

atomics.testName: ESXi - Avoslocker enumerates VMs and forcefully kills VMs
atomics.note: ESXi test that reproduces AvosLocker's VM enumeration and force-kill.

chain.procedure: Encrypts Windows and Linux/ESXi systems (.avos/.avos2 extensions) and threatens to publish the stolen data. The leak site has been offline since July 2023.

atomics.note: Drops a ransom note artifact. The encryptor itself is not reproduced.
